title: Parallel Governments
definition: Self-governing administrative structures established by Indian nationalists during the Quit India Movement (1942) to challenge British colonial authority by exercising sovereign functions like law enforcement, taxation, and judicial arbitration.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the radicalization of the freedom struggle, the decentralization of nationalist power, and the transition from protest politics to governance-based resistance.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Parallel Governments.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
